Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one high-quality production character turnaround sheet for building a coherent fully volumetric 3D anime character. Image 1 is the CANONICAL identity and palette: preserve this exact blue-haired, blue-eyed whale-maid girl, face silhouette, eye shape and spacing, bangs and long curled locks, moderate chibi head/body ratio, navy and ivory maid dress with a small whale apron, side bows and white maid headband, white socks and small rounded blue Mary Jane shoes, and the exact dark blue whale tail design. Image 2 supports the construction details of the SAME costume and soft curled hair, but must not override Image 1's face or dark palette. Create FOUR equally sized full-body views arranged left to right: front, right three-quarter 45 degrees, exact right side 90 degrees, and exact back. All views are the SAME individual and the same relaxed neutral standing pose, scale and ground line, with gentle arms out so wrists/cuffs are visible. This is a consistent turntable, not different character designs. Construct a real rounded cranium with coherent cheek/jaw/nose profile, a neck actually joining shoulders, a compact three-dimensional chest and pelvis, round limbs, rounded shoes with a plausible heel and toe, a continuously encircling puffed skirt with layered frills and a plausible waistband, and volumetric curved hair masses rooted on a rounded scalp. Keep the original characteristic big eyes and gentle smile, no older or generic anime face. Hair is full and curled to the hips with the same silhouette; the back is logically designed from the front, not a repeated face or a flat blue panel. The tail attaches behind the pelvis and curves consistently in 3D; its existing two flukes and navy/medium-blue bands must rotate coherently with the body. The skirt's volume and lower edge must be coherent from the side, not a front-picture V-shaped extrusion. Preserve the exact clothing design, not a new dress. Anime cel-painted/NPR animation look with soft volumetric shading and fine controlled outlines, matching the reference rather than a plastic toy. Unknown side/back details should be simple logical continuations of this design. Clean transparent background, generous separation between complete figures, no cropping, no UI, no props, no extra characters, no new logos, no text labels or captions.
